If 1€ in ads brings 3€, reinvest. If it brings 0.50€, change the ad. Simple, merciless.

questions: how to manage time as an entrepreneur
knowledge.answer:
Block your tasks in time slots, phone on silent ⏰
Mornings: the important work. Messages: at fixed hours, not continuously.
Answering every notification means letting others choose your day 😄

25 minutes of focus, 5 of break, repeat 🍅
The brain holds 25 minutes of focus well — the timer knows it.
4 sessions = 2h of deep work. You'd be amazed what that unlocks.

Sending and receiving money by simple SMS or app 📲
Orange Money, MTN MoMo: a silent revolution in Africa.
You can collect from a client in Conakry from Casablanca in 3 seconds. Money moves at phone speed.

Going from informal to formal opens doors 🏛️
Invoicing companies, loan access, public tenders: all require legal status.
Start simple in your country, then evolve. A declared company grows further than an invisible one.

Small and Medium Enterprises: roughly 5 to 250 employees 🏪
In Africa, SMEs provide most jobs.
A well-run corner shop is an SME. Never underestimate small beginnings.

Going to find clients instead of waiting 🎯
Personalized messages, targeted calls, presence where they are.
Game rule: 10 serious contacts beat 100 copy-pasted messages. Personalization is 80% of the work.

questions: how to handle an unhappy customer
knowledge.answer:
Listen first, fully, without defending yourself 👂
Then apologize sincerely and offer a concrete fix.
A well-handled problem builds more loyalty than a flawless service. Handled well, an angry customer becomes an ambassador.

B2B: you sell to companies. B2C: to individuals 🎯
B2B = fewer clients, bigger baskets, long cycles.
B2C = volume, emotion, speed. Many businesses do both — like us, by the way 😊

Your network opens doors job boards never heard of 🚪
A contact, a referral, advice at the right moment.
Simple rule: give first. Those who give, receive. Networking is sowing before harvesting.

Money in and out, in real time 💧
A company can be profitable on paper and die of cash shortage.
Survival rule: always keep enough to cover 3 months of charges. Cash is a business's oxygen.

questions: how to remind a client about payment
knowledge.answer:
Gentle follow-up: "Hi, hope you're well, the invoice from [date] is now due" 📨
Steps: 1st friendly reminder, 2nd firm, 3rd with agreed penalty.
Getting paid is customer service too — firm, but always respectful.

In West Africa, facing the Atlantic Ocean 🇬🇳
Neighbors: Mali, Senegal, Guinea-Bissau, Sierra Leone, Côte d'Ivoire, Liberia.
Nicknamed "West Africa's water tower" — you'll see why 😊

4 regions, 4 characters:
🌊 Lower Guinea (coast, Conakry) — ⛰️ Middle Guinea (Fouta Djallon) — 🌾 Upper Guinea (savanna, Kankan) — 🌳 Forest Guinea (N'Zérékoré).
One country, four worlds. That's Guinea's wealth.

Guinea's roof, in Middle Guinea ⛰️
A green plateau where the Niger, Senegal and Gambia rivers are born — hence "water tower".
Cool climate, breathtaking landscapes, towns like Labé, Mamou, Pita. A treasure to visit.

questions: where does the niger river start
knowledge.answer:
In Guinea! It's born in the Fouta Djallon, under the name Bafing 💧
Then it flows through Mali, Niger, Nigeria to the ocean.
One of Africa's great rivers is Guinean at its source. Proud 🇬🇳

Guinea's roof: ~1,752 meters, UNESCO heritage 🏔️
At the border with Côte d'Ivoire and Liberia, a unique nature reserve.
Its zone holds species found nowhere else. A jewel to protect.

A little paradise archipelago, 30 minutes by boat from Conakry 🏝️
Kassa, Roume, Tamara, Fotoba: sandy beaches, palm trees, turquoise water.
Conakrykas' weekend escape. A piece of paradise, truly.

Conakry is buzzing! 🌆
The Grand Mosque Fayçal, Madina Market, Niger Market, the corniche at sunset, the National Museum.
And at night, the maquis vibe with music and grilled food. Conakry never sleeps 😄

The Grand Mosque Fayçal of Conakry, one of West Africa's largest 🕌
Capacity ~25,000 worshippers, sumptuous Moroccan style.
A source of national pride and a landmark of the city.

Conakry the capital, of course 🇬🇳
Then: Kankan (Upper Guinea's capital), Labé and Mamou (Fouta), Kindia (Guinea's garden), N'Zérékoré (forest region), Boké and Kamsar (mining).
Each city has its character — that's what makes inland travel fascinating.

questions: dry and rainy season in guinea
knowledge.answer:
Two main seasons:
☀️ Dry season: November to May, blue skies, cool harmattan.
🌧️ Rainy season: June to October, generous rains especially on the coast and Fouta.
To visit: December-February, perfect weather. To see green Guinea: right after the rains, everything explodes 🌿

French is official, but the real wealth is the national languages 🗣️
Susu (coast), Malinké (Upper Guinea), Pular/Fula (Fouta), Kissi, Toma, Kpèlè (forest region).
Most Guineans speak 2-3 of them. Guinea is naturally multilingual!

The Guinean franc (GNF) 💵
1€ ≈ 11,000 GNF — prices in Guinea are often counted in thousands.
And everywhere: Orange Money and MTN MoMo now settle almost everything, even at the market.

On October 2, 1958, Guinea said "NO" to General De Gaulle 🇬🇳
The first French colony in Africa to choose immediate independence, led by Sékou Touré.
"We prefer poverty in freedom to wealth in servitude." A sentence that traveled the world.

Guinea sits on a treasure: bauxite 🪙
The world's #1 reserve! The world's aluminum often starts its journey in Guinea.
Add the iron of Simandou, the gold of Siguiri, Fouta agriculture — immense potential.

The world's largest untapped iron deposit 🏗️
In Guinea's southeast, with a 600+ km railway project to the coast.
At full capacity, it could transform the Guinean economy. The whole world is watching Guinea.

Get hungry 😋
Sunday's riz gras, sauce graine, plantain fouté, chicken bicyclette grilled over wood.
And Conakry's maquis at night: grilled fish, attiéké, live music. Guinea is tasted as much as visited.

Guinea is a musical powerhouse 🎶
Bembeya Jazz National, Mory Kanté (the famous "Yé ké yé ké"!), Sekouba Bambino, Sory Kandia — the Guinean griot school is legendary.
Kora, balafon, djembe: all of Africa recognizes the Guinean touch.

Madina is Conakry's beating heart 🛍️
A giant labyrinth where you find EVERYTHING: fabrics, loincloths, spices, phones, even spare parts.
Niger Market for upscale, Madina for authentic. Bargaining required, smiling recommended 😄

Guinea is full of waterfalls 💦
Kambadaga, Kinkon, Saala... the Fouta Djallon is sprinkled with them.
Natural pools at the foot of falls, amid green mountains. Still barely touristic = preserved paradise.

Red, Yellow, Green 🇬🇳
Red: the blood of independence martyrs. Yellow: gold and the sun. Green: vegetation and prosperity.
And the motto: "Work, Justice, Solidarity." National pride in three colors.

questions: how many people live in guinea
knowledge.answer:
~14 million inhabitants, over 1.7 million in Conakry 🌍
A very young population: the majority is under 25.
A connected, entrepreneurial, multilingual youth — the future growing strong in Guinea.

Guinea is a majority Muslim country (~85%) 🕌
With Christian and animist communities living together in peace.
Ramadan, Tabaski, Christmas: the holidays punctuate the year and bring everyone together. Guinean tolerance is a real lesson.

3 criteria: simple, memorable, timeless ✨
Simple = readable small and far. Memorable = recognized in 1 second. Timeless = still handsome in 10 years.
Nike, Apple, MTN: none reinvented the wheel. Simplicity is design's luxury.

questions: what does a brand guide include
knowledge.answer:
A brand's visual instruction manual 📘
Logo + variants, exact colors, typography, sizes, what's forbidden.
It guarantees your brand looks the same everywhere: flyer, socials, invoice. The discipline that turns "pretty" into "pro".

Colors speak before words 🎨
Blue = trust (banks, tech). Red = energy (food, sport). Green = nature/health. Gold = prestige. Black = luxury.
Tip: choose the color of the emotion your client should feel, not just your favorite.

The art of choosing characters ✍️
Serif = classic, serious. Sans serif = modern, clean.
Rule: 2 fonts max per visual. Beyond that, the eye gets lost. Readability always beats originality.

Branding = the promise + the personality + the consistency 🌟
The logo is just the face; the brand is the character.
What people say about you when you're not there — that's your real brand. Design just makes it visible.

Revealing a photo's best without lying ✨
Light, skin tone, sharpness, framing: we fix what the camera missed.
Good retouching doesn't show — it's felt. The photo just looks... right. That's our specialty at KOMARA 😄

Assembling shots into a story that holds 🎬
Rhythm, cuts, music, subtitles: every second must serve the message.
On TikTok/Reels, the first 3 seconds decide if people stay. That's where everything is won.

Graphics that move 🎞️
Animated logos, dancing text, moving infographics.
A motion video explains a complex idea in 30 seconds — perfect for that concept nobody gets at first 😄

questions: what is ux and ui design
knowledge.answer:
UX = the experience (is it fluid?). UI = the interface (is it beautiful?) 🖱️
UX thinks the journey, UI thinks the visual emotion.
A gorgeous site where you find nothing fails. An efficient but ugly site scares people. You need both.

The art of making a site clear, fast and desirable 🌐
Hierarchy: the essential big, the rest quiet. Breathing: empty space is your friend.
A visitor decides in 5 seconds whether to stay. Web design is winning those 5 seconds.

The product's first handshake 📦
Good packaging tells: who you are, why it's better, who it's for.
In stores, 70% of purchase decisions happen at the shelf. Packaging is your silent 24/7 salesperson.

The mood board you build before creating 🖼️
Images, colors, textures, keywords: fix the style BEFORE drawing.
Saves 10 rounds of revisions. Client and designer look in the same direction from the start.

Each network has its shape 📐
9:16 vertical: Stories, Reels, TikTok, WhatsApp status. 1:1 square: Instagram feed. 16:9 horizontal: YouTube, LinkedIn.
One visual adapted nowhere = blurry everywhere. Adapt per format — that's the rule.

The poster that decides the click 🖼️
Expressive face, 3 words max, strong contrast: it must read on a phone screen.
The video can be a masterpiece: without a thumbnail, nobody clicks. It's the front door.

The carousel is the silent weapon 📊
Each slide holds 2 more seconds of attention — and Instagram pushes posts people swipe.
Perfect for: steps, before/after, mini-tutorials. And the mental swipe-up makes people see it all 😄

Printing: 300 dpi minimum 🖨️
Web: 72 dpi is enough (screens).
Sending a 72 dpi image to the printer = guaranteed blur. Always ask for the final size in cm before creating, never the reverse.

RGB = light of screens 🌈
CMYK = printing inks 🖨️
Rule: screen → RGB, flyer → CMYK. Converting too late shifts colors at the printer. A classic that costs money.

Generating visuals from a descriptive text 🤖
You write the style, the light, the mood — the AI paints in seconds.
Pro result = precise prompt + selection + retouching. AI is a brush, not an artist: the eye stays human 😊

The trade's classics 🛠️
Photoshop (photos), Illustrator (logos/vectors), Figma (interfaces), Premiere (video), Canva (quick and simple).
Canva helps a lot, but a pro logo stays vector — so it stays sharp at every size.

questions: what is an image ai prompt

Style + subject + light + format + mood. The more precise, the closer to your idea.

Site displaying weirdly? Clear the cache. Tech support's magic fix #1 😄

questions: how do you catch a virus
knowledge.answer:
A malicious program that installs itself and misbehaves 🦠
Shady attachments, pirate sites, infected USB keys.
Vaccine = updated antivirus + updates + common sense: don't click "you won" 😄

The vehicle that takes you on the Internet 🚗
Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge: they display the sites.

questions: what does working in IT mean
knowledge.answer:
Translating human needs into machine language 💻
A developer = a translator + a problem solver.
And no, you don't need to be a genius: logic, patience, and lots of coffee 😄

The detective of numbers 🕵️
He turns raw data into business decisions.
"Clients buy Tuesdays at 7pm" — he finds that, and it's gold bars for the company.

Nollywood produces 2,000+ films a year — more than Hollywood 🎬
Nigerian cinema speaks to Africans with African stories.
Proof: our stories fascinate the whole world. Africa no longer waits for permission.

Treasures you must absolutely read 📚
Chinua Achebe ("Things Fall Apart"), Ahmadou Kourouma, Mariama Bâ.

Gods with everything human: jealousy, love, anger ⚡

Greek mythology = humanity's first blockbuster 😄

The new ones (2007): Great Wall, Taj Mahal, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer...
Travel goal: one per year. Life's too short to wait 😄

questions: how is christmas celebrated around the world
knowledge.answer:
Up North: tree, snow and gifts 🎄
In Guinea: midnight mass, family meal, kids in new clothes.
Same heart everywhere: giving, gathering, celebrating. Christmas changes scenery, never spirit.

A month of fasting from dawn to sunset 🌙
But it's much more: sharing, prayer, family — and evening meals that bring everyone together.
At the end: Eid, the celebration, kids, brand-new boubous. The warmest month of the year for many.

The sheep festival 🐑 — the biggest Muslim celebration.
Each family sacrifices a sheep, shares in three: family, relatives, the poor.
In West Africa, Tabaski means boubous, dressed-up kids, and total generosity.

The biggest annual human migration: billions of trips 🐉
Red everywhere (lucky), lion dances, red envelopes with money.
Each year has a zodiac animal. Did you know the festival lasts 15 days?

Much more than a drink: a ritual of hospitality 🫖
Green tea, fresh mint, sugar — poured from high for the foam, an art.
Refusing tea in Morocco is refusing friendship. Wait for the 3rd glass: it's tradition 😄

Four great spiritual families 🌍
Christianity (~2.4B), Islam (~2B), Hinduism (~1.2B), Buddhism (~500M).

The fabric that speaks 🧵
Wax, bogolan, Ghanaian kente: every pattern and color tells status, proverb, joy.
Wearing the pagne is wearing history. And Saturday at weddings — Africa's red carpet 😄

The body that tells stories 💃
Sowing dances, masks, ceremonies: every gesture has meaning.
From Senegalese sabar to Guinean ballets — Africa dances its life. And the world copies us, frankly 😄

A family affair, not just two people's 💍
The dowry seals the alliance between two families: ceremony, kola nuts, family heads, witnesses.
It can last days — and ends in an unforgettable party. An African wedding is an experience.

questions: uncle aunt and cousins in africa
knowledge.answer:
In Africa, family doesn't stop at your parents 🌳
Uncles, aunts, cousins: all "dad" and "mom", all responsible for the child.
Your neighbor can scold you like your father. It takes a village — the formula existed long before the saying 😄

The label protecting humanity's treasures 🏛️
1,200+ sites: from Mount Nimba 🇬🇳 to the Great Wall.
Listed = protected forever. Guinea is on it — our wonders rival the world's.

questions: how people greet around the world
knowledge.answer:
Firm handshake in the West, "Salam alaykum" back home 🤝
Namaste in India, a bow in Japan, nose-to-nose for Maoris.

Africa is fashion's new capital ✨

Wrestling in Senegal fills entire stadiums 🤼
More than a sport: rites, songs, griots and bets — football is jealous.
And Ethiopian marathon, Nigerian Dambe boxing: Africa has always grown champions.
